notes.title: Content Pack #1: Patch Notes for version 0.8.250501
notes.content:
[h3]Ahoy, Sailors![/h3]
For May's patch we have our first content pack, which features a new weapon, new enemy, balance updates, and Steam Cloud Saves!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Steam[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]Added Steam Cloud Saves[/b][/i]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Achievement: Min-Maxer:[/b][/i] Max out a stat
[*] ✨[i][b]New Achievement: Purist:[/b][/i] Win a run with a single type of weapon
[*] Updated graphics for a few achievement
[/list][b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Weapon: The Spinner.[/b][/i] A rotating Tech weapon that blocks enemy projectiles. Upgrades increase rotation speed and damage. Gain second Spinner when maxed
[*] Anchor: Multiple anchors now bounce off of each other. Increased base price from $22 to $23
[*] Steering now adds 1° for homing weapons seeking cones per Steering °/second
[*] Torpedo: base seeking angle: 160° (0 Steering)
[*] Flaregun: base seeking angle: 140° (0 Steering)
[*] Sniper: now unlocked by default
[/list][b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Enemy: Seahorse.[/b][/i] A small fish-type wondering enemy that shoots slow-moving horizontal projectiles
[*] Kraken: Decreased head maximum health by 4%. Decreased projectiles rate by 50%
[*] Tentacle: Increased projectile speed from 3 to 3.25
[*] Increased the number of Fish spawned in wave 19
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy projectiles would sometimes behave inconsistently
[/list][b]Boats[/b]
[list]
[*] Jeboat: increased base Fixing from 1 to 2, Increased base Attack Rate from 0 to 1. Now unlocks the Flaregun upon defeating wave 10.
[*] Icebreaker: now unlocks The Spinner upon defeating wave 10
[*] Yacht: now unlocks the Rifle upon defeating wave 10
[/list][b]Crew[/b]
[list]
[*] Fisherman/Big Game Hunter: Reduced damage increase against Elites from +30% to +20%.
[*] Otter/Carnivore: Reduced damage increase against Fish, Squids and Crustaceans from +25% to +20%
[/list][b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] New animation plays to show stat gained from random promotions
[*] Changed coral designs to better read as corals
[*] Updated Kraken ink puddle graphics
[*] Added a reticle snap animation when moving between targets
[*] Slightly modified the color palettes: Abyss, Sunset
[*] Modified ordering of various sprites in scene for more consistency
[*] Redesigned cargo pips for crew and weapons for better readability
[*] Slightly modified aim visuals: Harpoon, Torpedo, Cannon
[*] Updated Stat text and pips to be slightly lighter for better readability
[*] Fixed a minor typo at the end game screen

[/list][h2]Leave a review![/h2]

notes.title: 1,200 Wishlists and New Control Scheme! 🐙
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy, Sailors![/h2]
We just reached 1,200 wishlists! Thank you for checking out the game during the Automobile and Raid Survivors festivals, I hope you enjoy the demo! I have some cool updates for you, so buckle up.

[h3][b]Updates[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] [b][i]New Feature:[/i] Casual Controls:[/b] You can now choose between "Expert Mode" tank controls and a new and simpler "Casual Mode" control scheme. Casual Mode is the default, but you can switch back in the Controls menu.
[*] [b]Performance:[/b] Fixed several performance issues that caused severe frame drops for some players.
[*] [b]Factory:[/b] Increased coin generation rates significantly.
[*] [b]Stats:[/b] The Speed stat now provides a greater speed boost.
[*] [b]Deckhand:[/b] Rope Master now increases Speed instead of Steering.
[*] [b]Visuals:[/b] Damage numbers now appear above the boat when hit.
[*] [b]Store:[/b] Fixed an issue where the store didn’t prioritize player-owned weapons correctly.
[*] [b]Enemies:[/b] Updated enemy stats and wave compositions.
[*] [b]Goal Trials:[/b] Adjusted Goal Trials to avoid being timed too close to the end of a wave.
[/list]
I continue doing daily development streams on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/idanrooze][b]Twitch[/b][/url] in case you want to say hi and see a little bit behind the curtain! Join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/e2ujkXB4wF][b]Discord[/b][/url] for more updates and discussions!
